artworks.label: Obsidian arrowhead
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for ember-rift. One tall ancient obsidian arrowhead, beautifully knapped black volcanic-glass facets, a single fine ember-orange molten seam tracing organically through its center, a few tiny rough basalt grains beneath its pointed base. Premium fine-art geological macro photography, realistic glossy black glass against matte char, restrained orange internal radiance, charcoal/slate/ember palette. No numbers, no tool handle, no geode, hexagonal spires or lava landscape. Entire subject centered, strong compact silhouette, generous18percent clear margins. Truly TRANSPARENT empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque square, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure art only: no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. No crop/copy/recolour of any existing piece.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
